mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona Area High School. We have a waning gibbous moon tonight, and the temperature will dip to a low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city is busy with updates, including a reminder that road surface treatment begins August 4 on Lincoln Street, and don't forget the city has a toilet rebate program that offers 100 dollars back for installing high-efficiency models.

There is so much happening today, from the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school to the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree at Seven Acre Dairy Company and the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol.
In our weekly police report, on July 23, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive where a man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day before they close at 10:30 PM, and make sure to catch the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM.
